findings.highlight: I run into the park
findings.evidenceJa: 脇目もふらず公園に駆け込む
findings.governingReading: I charge into the park without looking aside
findings.explanation: The headlong, single-minded quality of Shirou’s entry is omitted.

findings.highlight: like oil polluting a clean stream
findings.evidenceJa: 清流の中に重油が流れているようなもの
findings.governingReading: like heavy fuel oil flowing through a clear stream
findings.explanation: The dense industrial pollutant and flowing image are weakened.

findings.highlight: She has analyzed the situation before me
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の目は俺より早く、何が起きているのかを把握した
findings.governingReading: her eyes grasped what was happening before mine did
findings.explanation: Immediate visual recognition becomes abstract analysis.

findings.highlight: fills with disgust and hatred
findings.evidenceJa: 不快感と嫌悪しかない
findings.governingReading: holds nothing but discomfort and revulsion
findings.explanation: Hatred is added to Shirou’s response.

findings.highlight: vampires in stories
findings.evidenceJa: 伝説に言う吸血鬼
findings.governingReading: the vampire spoken of in legend
findings.explanation: A singular archetypal comparison becomes generic fictional vampires.

findings.highlight: The dripping blood
findings.evidenceJa: 滴り落ちる紅い筋
findings.governingReading: the crimson streak dripping down
findings.explanation: The visible streak and its color disappear.

findings.highlight: Her skin is like grave wax. losing vitality.
findings.evidenceJa: 肌から生気の失われつつある女性
findings.governingReading: the woman whose skin is steadily losing its vitality
findings.explanation: The English inserts grave wax and breaks the sentence grammatically.

findings.highlight: She looks like she’s been turned into a doll
findings.evidenceJa: 生きながらにして人形に変えられたかのよう
findings.governingReading: as though she had been turned into a doll while still alive
findings.explanation: The horror that the victim remains alive during the transformation is omitted.

findings.highlight: the clear figure that is watching over the woman in black
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い女を見守る、間違いようのない人影
findings.governingReading: the unmistakable human figure watching the woman in black
findings.explanation: An unmistakably human watcher becomes merely a visually clear figure.

findings.highlight: do what you came to do
findings.evidenceJa: もっとシャンとしろよ
findings.governingReading: pull yourself together
findings.explanation: Shinji’s taunt about Shirou’s composure becomes an instruction to act.

findings.highlight: My mind is about to explode
findings.evidenceJa: 感じる理性が、とびかけている
findings.governingReading: the reason that should register the threat is about to fail
findings.explanation: Loss of threat-assessing reason becomes an exploding mind.

findings.highlight: This is my only option
findings.evidenceJa: なら結果は一つじゃないか
findings.governingReading: then there can be only one outcome
findings.explanation: The victim’s inevitable result becomes Shinji’s claim that he has no alternative.

findings.highlight: She says she can only feed on live people
findings.evidenceJa: こいつらは生しか口に合わない
findings.governingReading: these creatures will eat nothing but raw or living fare
findings.explanation: The English singularizes the class, adds that Rider reported the fact, and narrows its phrasing.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what’s funny, but Shinji laughs
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントを維持するには魔力を与え続けるしかない
findings.governingReading: a Servant must continually be supplied with magical energy to maintain it
findings.explanation: The English inserts an entire narration sentence saying Shinji laughs with no active Japanese counterpart.

findings.highlight: she will turn into a murderous devil once the order is given
findings.evidenceJa: 躊躇わず人を殺す悪鬼の類
findings.governingReading: a kind of demon that will kill without hesitation once ordered
findings.explanation: Rider’s described nature becomes a transformation caused by receiving an order.

findings.highlight: trembling in fear
findings.evidenceJa: ぶるぶる震えてさ
findings.governingReading: trembling all over
findings.explanation: The English explicitly assigns fear where Shinji only mocks visible trembling.

findings.highlight: Shinji’s eyes light up with hatred
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の目に敵意がともる
findings.governingReading: hostility lights in Shinji’s eyes
findings.explanation: Hostility is intensified into hatred.

findings.highlight: the Servant in black jumps forward
findings.evidenceJa: 黒いサーヴァントの体が沈み
findings.governingReading: the black Servant lowers or sinks her body
findings.explanation: Rider’s preparatory compression is changed into the completed leap.

findings.highlight: Stay back, Shirou!
findings.evidenceJa: 出ます！　シロウは後ろに！
findings.governingReading: I am going in; Shirou, stay behind me
findings.explanation: Saber’s announcement of her own engagement is omitted.

findings.highlight: runs through the park
findings.evidenceJa: めまぐるしく地面を駆ける
findings.governingReading: dashes dizzyingly across the ground
findings.explanation: Rider’s speed and ground-level movement are generalized.

findings.highlight: Her long hair fluttering behind her, the enemy closes in
findings.evidenceJa: 敵は長い髪をなびかせ
findings.governingReading: the enemy closes in with her long hair streaming
findings.explanation: English syntax initially assigns Rider’s long hair to Saber.

findings.highlight: just like a stone statue
findings.evidenceJa: ただの木偶の坊
findings.governingReading: nothing but a useless wooden block or dummy
findings.explanation: Shinji’s insult about uselessness becomes a comparison to immobility.

findings.highlight: a third-class magus
findings.evidenceJa: マスターが三流なら
findings.governingReading: if the Master is third-rate
findings.explanation: Shinji’s insult targets Shirou’s Mastership, not his quality as a magus.

findings.highlight: not a very talented magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての力はないようだ
findings.governingReading: appears to possess no power as a magus
findings.explanation: Complete apparent lack of magical capability is weakened to mediocre talent.

findings.highlight: She looks troubled
findings.evidenceJa: その顔は苦しげだ
findings.governingReading: her face looks pained
findings.explanation: Saber’s physical strain becomes emotional concern.

findings.highlight: We followed grandfather’s orders
findings.evidenceJa: 爺さんの言いつけは守ったんだ
findings.governingReading: I obeyed Grandfather’s instruction
findings.explanation: Shinji’s boast about his own compliance is reassigned to a plural subject.

findings.highlight: It doesn’t matter
findings.evidenceJa: 不可抗力さ
findings.governingReading: it would be unavoidable or force majeure
findings.explanation: Shinji’s self-exculpating claim of unavoidable necessity becomes indifference.

findings.highlight: I blankly stare
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は愕然と
findings.governingReading: I stare in utter shock
findings.explanation: Shirou’s shock at Saber’s superiority becomes vacant staring.

findings.highlight: his Servant, who has her belly sliced open. is severely wounded
findings.evidenceJa: 腹を裂かれ、深手を負ったライダー
findings.governingReading: Rider, her abdomen split and gravely wounded
findings.explanation: The two coordinated injuries are broken into malformed English.

findings.highlight: I became your Master
findings.evidenceJa: この僕がマスターになってやったのに
findings.governingReading: I, of all people, deigned to become your Master
findings.explanation: Shinji’s condescending claim that Mastership was a favor to Rider is neutralized.

findings.highlight: use your life to stop them
findings.evidenceJa: 体を張って食い止めろ
findings.governingReading: put your body on the line and hold them off
findings.explanation: Using the body as a shield is escalated into spending Rider’s life.

findings.highlight: move Rider using your Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪で酷使したところで
findings.governingReading: even if you drive the dying Rider mercilessly with a Command Spell
findings.explanation: The coercive overwork imposed on dying Rider is omitted.

findings.highlight: revoke your Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪を破棄し
findings.governingReading: relinquish your Command Spells
findings.explanation: Plural surrender of the remaining Command Spells becomes revocation of one spell.

findings.highlight: Shinji is condemning her for not being able to get up
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の命令が立ち上がれないライダーを責めている
findings.governingReading: Shinji’s command itself punishes Rider for being unable to rise
findings.explanation: The supernatural feedback of the command becomes ordinary verbal condemnation.

findings.highlight: her life is draining away
findings.evidenceJa: 急速にその命を失いつつあった
findings.governingReading: her life is rapidly draining away
findings.explanation: The accelerating collapse of Rider’s life is omitted.

findings.highlight: at least take her with you
findings.evidenceJa: こいつを道連れにして消えやがれ
findings.governingReading: take her with you and disappear
findings.explanation: Shinji’s command that Rider perish after taking Saber with her is partly omitted.

findings.highlight: The sound of crackling flames
findings.evidenceJa: ぼう、という音
findings.governingReading: a soft woof of ignition
findings.explanation: The single ignition sound becomes sustained crackling.

findings.highlight: The book turns to ashes
findings.evidenceJa: 本は跡形もなく焼失し
findings.governingReading: the book burns away without a trace
findings.explanation: Total disappearance is changed to remaining ashes.

findings.highlight: appears out of the darkness of the night
findings.evidenceJa: 夜の闇から滲み出るように現れていた
findings.governingReading: appeared as though seeping from the darkness of night
findings.explanation: Zouken’s unnatural, viscous entrance image is omitted.

findings.highlight: my successor
findings.evidenceJa: 我が血脈の後継者
findings.governingReading: the heir to my bloodline
findings.explanation: Zouken’s dynastic accusation becomes a generic personal succession.

findings.highlight: enough pride to challenge others in spite of your powerlessness
findings.evidenceJa: 無力でありながらも挑む我らの誇り
findings.governingReading: our pride in challenging despite our powerlessness
findings.explanation: The inherited Makiri collective pride Zouken demanded is reduced to Shinji possessing enough individual pride.

findings.highlight: The old man turns away from Shinji in disgust and walks toward us
findings.evidenceJa: 老人は慎二を無視して歩き出す
findings.governingReading: the old man ignores Shinji and starts walking
findings.explanation: The English adds disgust and specifies that Zouken walks toward Shirou and Saber.

findings.highlight: Saber retreats
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはかすかに後じさる
findings.governingReading: Saber edges back slightly
findings.explanation: A small involuntary backward step becomes a tactical retreat.

findings.highlight: She must have felt something ominous in the old man
findings.evidenceJa: 老人に不吉なものを感じたのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps sensing something ominous in the old man
findings.explanation: The narrator’s tentative interpretation is promoted to certainty.

findings.highlight: I do not think a heroic spirit as great as you was ever summoned
findings.evidenceJa: 過去の戦いにおいても一人現れたかどうか
findings.governingReading: perhaps only one Servant of this caliber appeared even in the wars of the past
findings.explanation: A deliberately uncertain rarity estimate becomes an assertion that no comparable Heroic Spirit was ever summoned.

findings.highlight: No matter how pitiful he may be, he is still my grandson
findings.evidenceJa: あのようなものでも血縁でな
findings.governingReading: even a thing like that is still my blood relation
findings.explanation: Zouken’s dehumanizing contempt is softened into pity and ordinary grandparental relation.

findings.highlight: must be confronting Saber so that he can protect Shinji
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二を守っているのか
findings.governingReading: is he facing Saber in order to protect Shinji?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s incredulous tentative interpretation is promoted to certainty.

findings.highlight: as he retreats
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの目から逃れていく
findings.governingReading: escapes from Saber’s sight while glaring at the old man
findings.explanation: Saber’s control of Shinji’s escape and his gaze at Zouken are omitted.

findings.highlight: Saber stands like a statue, her eyes locked with his
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは老人と対峙したまま動かない
findings.governingReading: Saber remains motionless while confronting the old man
findings.explanation: The English adds a statue simile and mutual locked-eye staging.

findings.highlight: You should not have anything to tell him, nor should you have anything to hear from him
findings.evidenceJa: 話す事などなく、聞く事もない筈です
findings.governingReading: there can be nothing to say to him and nothing to hear from him
findings.explanation: Saber’s categorical judgment is weakened into advice about what Shirou should do.

findings.highlight: Saber pulls herself back a bit. She does not back up
findings.evidenceJa: わずかに体を引くセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber draws her body back slightly without yielding the way
findings.explanation: The English first says Saber backs up and then immediately denies it, obscuring that she yields conversational space while holding the path.

findings.highlight: I gave the stage to my grandson
findings.evidenceJa: 孫に桧舞台を譲った
findings.governingReading: I yielded the grand or prestigious stage to my grandson
findings.explanation: Zouken’s grandiose theatrical metaphor is flattened.

findings.highlight: the lowest seat in a family of magi
findings.evidenceJa: 魔道を究める血の末席
findings.governingReading: one at the furthest end of a bloodline pursuing the Way of Magic
findings.explanation: A genealogical position within a magical lineage becomes a social seat in an unspecified family.

findings.highlight: Magi become Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 原則として、マスターとは魔術師がなるものだ
findings.governingReading: as a rule, Masters are people who are magi
findings.explanation: The default qualification for Masters is reversed into a general claim that magi become Masters.

findings.highlight: Shinji knows magic
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は魔術を学んでいて
findings.governingReading: Shinji has studied Magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category Magecraft is generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: The families of Matou and Tohsaka live in this land
findings.evidenceJa: 両家が根を張っておる
findings.governingReading: both families have put down roots in this land
findings.explanation: Long-established occult and territorial roots become mere residence.

findings.highlight: our bloodline has died out
findings.evidenceJa: とうに我が血族は廃れておる
findings.governingReading: our bloodline has long since declined
findings.explanation: The still-living Matou line’s decline is changed to literal extinction.

findings.highlight: The Tohsaka family has the right to this land
findings.evidenceJa: この土地の権利は名実ともに遠坂のもの
findings.governingReading: in name and in fact, the rights to this land belong to Tohsaka
findings.explanation: The completeness of Tohsaka’s present ownership is weakened.

findings.highlight: is living, clinging onto its former right
findings.evidenceJa: 細々と生きているにすぎん
findings.governingReading: does nothing more than eke out a meager existence by clinging to its former rights
findings.explanation: The diminished scale of Matou survival is omitted.

findings.highlight: We were once allies
findings.evidenceJa: 我らと遠坂はかつての同朋
findings.governingReading: we and the Tohsaka were once comrades
findings.explanation: Shared membership in the original undertaking becomes a strategic alliance.

findings.highlight: We have been enemies ever since the ritual became violent
findings.evidenceJa: 儀式が争いに変貌してからは袂を分かった
findings.governingReading: we parted ways after the ritual transformed into a conflict
findings.explanation: A historical separation is strengthened into continuing enmity, while the ritual becoming conflict becomes the ritual itself becoming violent.

findings.highlight: how talented his apprentice is
findings.evidenceJa: 彼奴の弟子がどれほどの器か
findings.governingReading: what caliber or capacity his apprentice possesses
findings.explanation: Zouken’s appraisal of Rin’s overall vessel or stature is narrowed to talent.

findings.highlight: He laughs
findings.evidenceJa: 呵々、という笑い声
findings.governingReading: a resounding ka-ka laugh
findings.explanation: Zouken’s distinctive old-fashioned laugh is flattened.

findings.highlight: laughs happily
findings.evidenceJa: 愉快そうに哄笑する
findings.governingReading: roars with laughter as though greatly amused
findings.explanation: The volume and grotesque force of Zouken’s laughter disappear.

findings.highlight: We came to this country with the name Matou
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐と名を偽りこの国に根を下ろした
findings.governingReading: we falsified our name as Matou and put down roots in this country
findings.explanation: The deliberate false identity and establishment of roots are omitted.

findings.highlight: They are actually called Makiri
findings.evidenceJa: マキリという名前を変換しただけのもの
findings.governingReading: Matou is merely a transformation of the name Makiri
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition of the constructed name is changed into a simple correction of the family’s actual name.

findings.highlight: has not taught you anything
findings.evidenceJa: まともな教育をしなかった
findings.governingReading: did not give you a proper education
findings.explanation: Zouken’s criticism of Kiritsugu’s magical education is expanded to total failure to teach Shirou anything.

findings.highlight: Sakura has no talent
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての素養がない
findings.governingReading: Sakura lacks aptitude as a magus
findings.explanation: The domain of the questioned aptitude is omitted.

findings.highlight: magi families have only one inheritor
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の家系は一子相伝が基本
findings.governingReading: magus families fundamentally transmit their art to a single child
findings.explanation: A rule about exclusive transmission of Magecraft becomes merely having one heir.

findings.highlight: pass magic to the inheritor
findings.evidenceJa: 後継者以外に魔術を伝える
findings.governingReading: transmit Magecraft to anyone besides the successor
findings.explanation: Magecraft is generalized to magic, and the source’s prohibited recipients are recast positively.

findings.highlight: And a sister of all that
findings.evidenceJa: 兄妹など最たるものだ
findings.governingReading: siblings are the clearest example
findings.explanation: The statement that siblings exemplify the inheritance problem becomes malformed English.

findings.highlight: if our family had not died out
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の名が廃れていなければ
findings.governingReading: if the Matou name had not declined
findings.explanation: Decline in the family name and standing is again changed to literal extinction.

findings.highlight: involve someone who knows nothing of the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争に駆り出す
findings.governingReading: drag a granddaughter who knows nothing into the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: Zouken’s image of forcibly fielding Sakura is softened to involvement.

findings.highlight: Sakura doesn’t need to concern herself with such a murderous war
findings.evidenceJa: 桜がこんな殺し合いに関わらなくていい
findings.governingReading: Sakura does not have to become involved in this killing contest
findings.explanation: Relief that Sakura is not materially involved becomes relief that she need not concern herself mentally.

findings.highlight: He is stubbornly determined to be a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師というものに執念を抱いておる
findings.governingReading: he is consumed by an obsession with the very idea of being a magus
findings.explanation: Shinji’s pathological fixation is softened into determination.

findings.highlight: how he found out about our family secret
findings.evidenceJa: 何処で秘伝を紐解いたのか
findings.governingReading: where he managed to decipher the secret tradition
findings.explanation: Shinji’s active recovery of esoteric knowledge becomes passive discovery of a family secret.

findings.highlight: knowing that he is inferior
findings.evidenceJa: 生まれつき劣っているという強迫観念
findings.governingReading: a compulsion that he was born inferior
findings.explanation: Shinji’s pathological conviction becomes simple knowledge presented as fact.

findings.highlight: my fault for not being more strict with him
findings.evidenceJa: 放任が祟った
findings.governingReading: the consequences of leaving him neglected or unchecked
findings.explanation: Zouken’s admission of neglect is softened into insufficient strictness.

findings.highlight: Servant Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーのサーヴァントよ
findings.governingReading: Servant of the Saber class
findings.explanation: A class-based form of address becomes an awkward personal title.

findings.highlight: there is no reason for me to fight
findings.evidenceJa: 無益な戦いはしない
findings.governingReading: I will not engage in a fruitless battle
findings.explanation: Saber’s refusal is conditioned on utility, not the absence of any reason.

findings.highlight: I shall kill him without mercy
findings.evidenceJa: 容赦なく斬り捨てよう
findings.governingReading: I shall cut him down without mercy
findings.explanation: Saber’s sword-specific threat is generalized.

findings.highlight: What is this?
findings.evidenceJa: どのような穏形なのか
findings.governingReading: what kind of concealment art is this?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition of an unknown concealment technique disappears.

findings.highlight: melts into the night
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちの目の前で夜の闇に溶けていく
findings.governingReading: melts into the darkness of night before our eyes
findings.explanation: The uncanny visibility of Zouken’s disappearance is omitted.

findings.highlight: Oh, thanks, Saber
findings.evidenceJa: すまん、頼むセイバー
findings.governingReading: Sorry; I’m counting on you, Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s apology and explicit request for help become casual thanks.

findings.highlight: she is more powerful
findings.evidenceJa: 力ではセイバーの方が上
findings.governingReading: Saber is stronger than I am physically
findings.explanation: The practical comparison of carrying strength is generalized to overall power.

findings.highlight: Please stay behind me
findings.evidenceJa: 離れずに付いて来てください
findings.governingReading: follow me without falling behind or separating
findings.explanation: Saber’s command to keep close becomes a positional order to remain behind her.

findings.highlight: Saber starts running
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの体が流れる
findings.governingReading: Saber’s body flows forward
findings.explanation: The superhuman fluidity of Saber’s acceleration is flattened.
